title: Surf model contract
description: The boundary between the application and the surf model. Shared by packages/model (TypeScript) and swellkit (Python); both sides validate against this file so a field rename cannot drift silently. Everything is plain JSON — no dates, no language-specific types — because the model is intended to be reachable over a pipe.

tone.description: Condition label, ordered smallest to largest. Banded on breaking face height in feet: flat under 2, small to 4, solid to 6, large to 9, xl to 12, xxl above. 6ft is head high, 12ft double overhead.

isoUtc.description: ISO 8601 in UTC with milliseconds, as JavaScript's toISOString emits.

nullableNumber.description: Null means the instrument reported no value. It is never a zero.

observation.description: One buoy reading. Wave direction is whence the swell comes, not where it goes.

weight.description: How much one observation contributed. Carries no station name — attribution is the application's job.

facing.description: Degrees true the break faces. Absent means no directional weighting.

swellPower.description: Dimensionless index, H squared times T. Also the input to the breaking-height estimate.

faceHeight.description: Metres. Estimated breaking face height, trough to crest, which is the convention surf reports use. Derived from the offshore height and period, so it differs from waveHeight by roughly 1.25 to 2.0 depending on period.

faceHeightMax.description: Metres. The highest tenth of breaking waves, about 1.27 times faceHeight. Pair with faceHeight to report a range, since significant height is already a distribution.

observedAt.description: Earliest observation in the set. A forecast is only as fresh as this.
